name: agent-command-center
description: Live multi-agent monitor: agents, handoffs, tokens, quota, runtimes and ETAs in a persistent pane, from hook events only (zero extra LLM calls).

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Show toasts for quota/context thresholds, failed agents and finished requests

quotaWarn.title: Quota warning %
quotaWarn.description: Warn when the 5-hour or weekly quota passes this percent

ctxWarn.title: Context warning %
ctxWarn.description: Warn when the context window passes this percent

animations.title: Office animation
animations.description: Animate the office scene. Turn off for a still view (reduced motion)

officeWidth.title: Office width (px)
officeWidth.description: Drawn width of the office scene. Raise it for a bigger office, lower it if the pane is narrow

privacy.title: Privacy mode
privacy.description: strict (default): record no prompts, commands, file paths, outputs, errors or task text, only agent and tool names, counts, tokens and times. standard: also record shortened text, with secrets masked by pattern (a secret that looks like ordinary words can still be recorded)
